_readme: Copy to inbox/docs-config.json (gitignored). Each key is a case-insensitive piece of a FILE NAME. Matching documents are flagged: every search result from them carries a verify warning, and Claude can show you the original page image with view_document_page. mode 'warn' (default) returns the printed text WITH the warning; 'pointer-only' withholds the text and only points to the document and pages.
